topics.name: Maintenance Window
topics.purpose: Define bounded time window in which declared operational changes may be eligible, without making the window itself an authorization bypass.

semantics.identity_rule: Each maintenance window has explicit identity.
semantics.availability_rule: Expected service impact/maintenance mode is explicit.
semantics.authorization_rule: Window eligibility does not replace AccessCore/change approval.
semantics.emergency_rule: Emergency exceptions use separate explicit policy.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

references.purpose: Operational changes may reference exact windows.
